gavin_intro.speaker: gavin
gavin_intro.text: Halt, Archmage! Watch your footing near the causeway threshold! The Mirror isn't resting calm tonight. Black swell waves are lapping over the stone pavers, and the star-reflections below look like they're sinking into an abyss.

start_quest.title: Tide of Shadows
start_quest.desc: Investigate anomalous wave surges and void-shadows rising from the depths of the Mirror lake.
stages: Confer with Bridgewarden Gavin at the causeway gate
Monitor the dark tides surging against the stone piers
Enact an emergency tethering ritual to secure the crossing

choices.text: [Arcana Check] That's not water movement—it is gravitational tide distortion caused by the containment rig's spin-up cycle on the island.
[Resilience Check] Step behind me, Bridgewarden. I can anchor the causeway threshold with a starlight tether.
Has anyone attempted to cross the causeway during the surge?

gavin_explain.speaker: gavin
gavin_explain.text: A courier tried an hour ago. He said the middle of the bridge felt like walking on grease over an endless sky. Had to crawl back on hands and knees.

choices.text: We need to re-anchor the ward stones along the pier foundation.

gavin_arcana_pass.speaker: gavin
gavin_arcana_pass.text: Gravitational distortion? So the lake is literally warping space around the stone road! What do we do to keep travellers from falling through?

choices.text: [Voidweaver] Invert the anchor runes on the shore pylons to counteract the pull.

gavin_arcana_fail.speaker: gavin
gavin_arcana_fail.text: Another wave just hit the second pier! The spray is dissolving into cold black mist!

choices.text: Plant the grounding staff and brace the barrier.

gavin_resilience_pass.speaker: gavin
gavin_resilience_pass.text: By the gods, you held that surge back with pure will! The black water broke against your ward like glass on granite.

choices.text: Lock the boundary anchor into the bedrock.

gavin_action.speaker: gavin
gavin_action.text: The shore ward stones are glowing red-hot. Pour cold starlight into the left pylon while I secure the chain!

choices.text: Channel starlight into the pylon array.

gavin_resolve.speaker: gavin
gavin_resolve.text: The waves have smoothed out to glass. The star-reflections are clear and calm once more. The causeway is open for the scholars. Thank you, Voidweaver.
